name: sdlc
purpose: Coordinate durable BDD/contract delivery with isolated worktrees, versioned requirements and evidence-bound review.

criteria.description: Preserve the frozen initial workload, authorized amendments, requirement IDs and ADR decisions.
Inspect real BDD and producer/consumer contract results plus applicable current-head artifacts.
Verify sparse COW worktree ownership, pinned dependencies, bounded leases and quiescent recovery.
Use genuinely independent final requirement/evidence review and current native PR gates.

limits: Mechanical verification checks recorded facts and actual retained bytes; a recorded semantic inspection is not authenticated judgment.
Compilation and fixture success do not prove complete semantic workflow performance or provider/native-host activation.
The shared report gate does not replace sdlc.py gate, tasks gate, independent original-workload compliance review or live PR checks.
